name: Used Variable
hint: Initialized variables and lists store state that a project can reuse throughout its scripts.
instruction: Create a variable or list before its first use, then read or update it in the blocks that need the stored state.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
set [my variable v] to (0)
say [Hello!] for (2) seconds
change [my variable v] by (1)
